## 📖 Pull Request Description

### Summary
Provide a clear, concise summary of the changes introduced in this pull request and the problems it solves.

---

### 🏷️ Type of Change
- [ ] 🚀 `feat`: New feature or significant enhancement
- [ ] 🐛 `fix`: Bug fix
- [ ] 🎨 `style`: UI/styling improvements, 3D effects, or CSS updates
- [ ] 📚 `docs`: Documentation updates (README, CONTRIBUTING, etc.)
- [ ] ⚡ `perf`: Performance optimization
- [ ] ♻️ `refactor`: Code refactoring without functionality changes
- [ ] 🧪 `test`: Adding or updating tests
- [ ] 🔧 `chore`: Tooling, dependencies, or GitHub Actions CI updates

---

### 🌟 Key Changes & Highlights
- [ ] Feature 1: ...
- [ ] Feature 2: ...
- [ ] Feature 3: ...

---

### 🧪 Verification & Testing Checklist
- [ ] `npm run lint` executes with zero warnings or errors.
- [ ] `npm run build` generates production bundle successfully.
- [ ] Tested responsive behavior on mobile, tablet, and desktop screens.
- [ ] Verified LocalStorage persistence (Read List, Wishlist, Personal Notes).
- [ ] Verified Web Audio API ambience and Speech Synthesis.

---

### 📸 Visual Demonstration (Screenshots / GIFs)
_Attach screenshots or short video previews of the 3D cinematic animations or UI enhancements here._

---

### ✅ Pre-Merge Verification & Standards
- [ ] Branch follows standard naming: `feat/*`, `fix/*`, `docs/*`, `enhancement/*`.
- [ ] Commit messages adhere to [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/).
- [ ] Pull request is ready for review and automated CI verification.
